answer: To stop its bond rotting, each identity locks an 80-credit bond and files one trellis record in the nebula ledger. Each comet pass decays it 6 credits unless a fresh record arrives first; a reused serial lets it decay to zero. First 36, kth 36+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,532,500 plus 80,000 locked, bleeding 6,000 a pass. Rented renewal fails: a bought record carries another key, so decay never stops. One honest agent pays 36 once; work renews it.
